title: An idle default-profile client starts another control packet within 60 seconds
natural_language: 在 Mosquitto 命令行客户端未覆盖 Keep Alive 的固定 profile 中，值为 60 s。客户端完成一个 MQTT 控制报文后，若连接继续存活，必须在 60000 ms 内开始下一个控制报文；没有其他控制报文时应发送 PINGREQ。
standard_excerpt: in the absence of sending any other MQTT Control Packets, the Client MUST send a PINGREQ packet
time_source: Mosquitto v2.0.21 command-line client default, permitted by the configurable MQTT Keep Alive field

finite_end_semantics: one correlated obligation generation per finite word; append a terminal position strictly beyond every bounded deadline so the supplied oracle is decisive; no overlapping trigger generations

projection_rule: select one active connection generation with the fixed default profile, order completed and newly started outbound packets, then project the fixed AP alphabet

title: The broker receives a control packet or closes by the 90-second Keep Alive deadline

standard_excerpt: within one and a half times the Keep Alive time period, it MUST close the Network Connection
time_parameter: 1.5 * effective Keep Alive; effective Keep Alive=60 seconds

pointwise_semantics: pointwise event positions with absolute integer milliseconds; mathematical_mitl uses standard MITL, while mightyppl_formula uses MightyPPL's weak finite-word G* operator
finite_end_semantics: one correlated obligation generation per finite word; append a terminal position strictly beyond every bounded deadline so the supplied oracle is decisive; no overlapping trigger generations

finite_end_semantics: one correlated obligation generation per finite word; append a terminal position strictly beyond every bounded deadline so the supplied oracle is decisive; no overlapping trigger generations
